name: Narikiri Princess ~Onna ni Natta Boku o Mite!~
original_name: なりきりプリンセス～女になったボクを見て！～
source: You are to join the school's drama club, but the high-handed club president dresses you up as a girl and introduces you to the other club members as a girl.
translation: 你准备加入学校的戏剧社，强势的社长却把你打扮成女生，还将你以女生的身份介绍给其他社员。
